summary: Tested Event Setup Form with Category, Tags, Owner, Meeting Platform, and Timezone features. All 14 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified working - Category dropdown loads from /api/master/categories, Tags multi-select loads from /api/master/tags with colors, Primary Owner loads from /api/master/users with 'Add New' button, Meeting Platform dropdown appears when Virtual/Online mode selected with Zoom/Google Meet/Other options, Generate Link button visible when Zoom selected, Timezone dropdown includes Asia/Kolkata and 35+ IANA timezones.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend DTO requires 'location' field as mandatory - frontend sends it from address_1 field
When virtual_platform is 'zoom' or 'google-meet' and mode is online/hybrid, backend auto-generates meeting link via MeetingService
event_tags junction table correctly populated when tag_ids array is provided
seed_data_creation: Created test events via API: TEST Event with Category and Tags, TEST Virtual Event with Meeting URL, TEST Hybrid Event Full Form, TEST Event for Tags Junction, TEST Event with Asia/Kolkata Timezone
context_for_next_testing_agent: Event Setup Form fully working. Key features verified: 1) Category dropdown loads 8 categories from /api/master/categories (Conference, Workshop, Meetup, Awards, Webinar, Networking, Training, Seminar), 2) Tags multi-select loads 7 tags with colors from /api/master/tags (Technology, Business, Innovation, Networking, Startup, AI, Design), 3) Primary Owner dropdown loads users from /api/master/users with 'Add New' button for creating new owners, 4) When Event Mode is Virtual/Online or Hybrid, Meeting Platform dropdown appears with Zoom, Google Meet, Other options, 5) Zoom and Google Meet integrations are configured (status returns true), 6) Generate Link button appears when Zoom/Google Meet selected, 7) Timezone dropdown includes 35+ IANA timezones including Asia/Kolkata (India Standard Time), 8) Backend saves category_id to events table and tag_ids to event_tags junction table.
